scope: Read-only repair-design cross-review of prompt arbitrary-string keys and internal option markers; this artifact records already completed probes only.

preRepairSnapshot.observation: Observed after the supplemental probe run and before source repair authorization. This records that prior observation, not a new claim about the current repair working tree.

probe.interpretation: All six assertions expressed the expected corrected behavior and failed against the frozen pre-repair source. These are reproduction failures, not passing validations.
probe.evidenceSelection: The exact output path printed by this probe invocation was read; no latest pointer was used.

contractValidation.method: Direct readFileSync of the exact current protocol JSON, compiled using Ajv with strict=false, validateFormats=false and ownProperties=true; no runtime/validation import.

requestedSchema.propertiesDescription: An own __proto__ or constructor property created with Object.fromEntries; each property schema is type:string.

contractValidation.result: Each of the four MCP component cases passed the fixed full request schema assertion before failing its checkbox assertion.
contractValidation.questionIdContract: protocol/json/ToolRequestUserInputParams.json defines question id as an unrestricted string. The constructor component probe only supplies UI-consumed question fields and was not itself asserted to be a complete ToolRequestUserInputParams envelope.

confirmedRelatedFindings.classification: Confirmed shared root cause in arbitrary-string dictionary reads
confirmedRelatedFindings.rootCause: Plain bracket reads from initially empty ordinary objects return inherited Object.prototype values; field presence is then inferred from value !== undefined.

affectedPaths.flow: MCP standard form with a legal string property named __proto__ or constructor
affectedPaths.observed: The optional string field starts with its presence checkbox checked. After entering a value and clearing the presence checkbox, it renders checked again.
affectedPaths.expected: An omitted property starts absent and remains absent after clearing its own stored value.
affectedPaths.evidence: The first four assertions in the raw probe result failed with expected false, received true.

affectedPaths.flow: requestUserInput with legal question id constructor and no entered answer
affectedPaths.observed: Clicking submit calls onAnswer once; the answer array contains the inherited Object constructor function. JSON serialization of that array yields null instead of a user string.
affectedPaths.expected: An unanswered question must not dispatch a response.
affectedPaths.evidence: The fifth assertion failed and printed the actual onAnswer call containing [Function Object].

confirmedRelatedFindings.impact: Legal prompt identifiers and MCP property names cause incorrect presence state or invalid answer dispatch. This is a functional data-handling defect; no privilege escalation or real permission execution was tested.

boundedHelperObservation.status: Pure-data helper behavior confirmed; independent real UI flow not established
boundedHelperObservation.input: validateValue({type:object, properties:{}, additionalProperties:false}, JSON.parse containing an own __proto__ string property)
boundedHelperObservation.observed: Returns no validation errors because properties[key] resolves inherited Object.prototype.
boundedHelperObservation.expected: An undeclared own key should fail additionalProperties:false.
boundedHelperObservation.boundary: The current UI has no demonstrated legitimate path that creates this undeclared key. This helper fixture is not claimed to be a valid standard MCP requestedSchema, whose top-level contract does not allow additionalProperties. Do not promote this observation to an independent user-flow finding.

repairDesign: Use own-property reads for arbitrary question ids and schema keys, including answers, other, top-level content and recursive SchemaField access.
Construct the response dictionary using Object.create(null) or Object.fromEntries. Computed property creation in withField is safe to retain.
Represent option selection using internal indices or tagged state; map selections back to exact original labels only at submission. Keep free text distinct from internal Other state.
Use Object.hasOwn(properties, key) in prompt-validation rather than truthiness of properties[key].
boundaries: This is supplemental repair evidence, not a complete independent repository audit and not a clean audit round.

Nested object SchemaField access has the same code pattern, but the fixed standard MCP form contract does not permit nested object fields; it is not reported as a separate confirmed standard-form flow.
No source, tracked test, product documentation or sealed R21 report was changed. Only ignored probe files already created and this authorized supplemental JSON are involved.
No tests were rerun while recording this artifact. No real model, MCP, account, media, permission behavior, SSH or restricted-file investigation occurred.
The parent agent confirmed separate response-write and __other marker defects; this artifact does not claim those earlier probes as this reviewer own evidence.
